## Summary

What packaging, reproducibility, standards, or lifecycle problem does this change solve?

## Contract impact

- [ ] Build recipe/profile
- [ ] Deterministic packaging
- [ ] Verification/security boundary
- [ ] Runner/admission
- [ ] Standards/provenance
- [ ] Catalog/publication
- [ ] Documentation only

## Validation

List tests, fixture rebuilds, digest checks, standards checks, and lifecycle runs performed.

## Claim discipline

- [ ] No new scientific meaning is inferred by the compiler.
- [ ] Historical package identities remain immutable unless an explicitly new profile/version is introduced.
- [ ] Unknown/unavailable required inputs fail closed rather than becoming defaults.
